description: The pure-AST interpolation templates of lib/interp.esm (`searchsorted`, `linear`, `bilinear`), each applied to scenarios of tests/closed_functions/interp/<fn>/expected.json and asserted at tolerance 0, so every binding's expanded template reproduces the pinned binary64 reference values there. The query is a parameter, the arrays `const` nodes and each axis length an integer template argument used as a `faq` `ranges` bound (esm-spec §9.6.1).

scope_excluded.go: No simulator and no inline-test runner, so a tier that DRIVES one cannot be run here (API_SPEC.md §3, capability profiles). Go's template expansion of a `ranges` parameter is pinned by tests/conformance/expression_templates/ranges_param. This is an exclusion from the CATEGORY, not from the rule.
scope_excluded.typescript: No simulator and no inline-test runner, so a tier that DRIVES one cannot be run here (API_SPEC.md §3, capability profiles). TypeScript's template expansion of a `ranges` parameter is pinned by tests/conformance/expression_templates/ranges_param. This is an exclusion from the CATEGORY, not from the rule.

tolerances.detail: Every asserted value is the pinned binary64 reference value of tests/closed_functions, matched bit for bit.
